stepBody:
Which of the following options reduces model complexity?

• Decreasing $$\lambda.$$
• Increasing $$\lambda.$$
• Changing $$\lambda$$ has no effect on model complexity.
choices: Changing $$\lambda$$ has no effect on model complexity
Both increasing and decreasing $$\lambda$$ reduce complexity equally
The effect of $$\lambda$$ depends on the choice of $$\text{g}(\theta)$$
